SPACE ROBOTICS · RESEARCH

Tactile Perception for Deformable Linear Object Manipulation

Research direction: adaptive robotic manipulation of cables using tactile perception and uncertainty.

Research overview

This research explores how tactile information and uncertainty can support robotic manipulation of deformable linear objects, such as cables. The motivation is to improve manipulation when the shape of a flexible object changes during handling.

Current approach

  • Use tactile response and robot motion as input signals.
  • Estimate cable deformation using a data-driven model.
  • Represent estimation uncertainty and use it to inform control adaptation.
  • Study the approach through a simplified two-dimensional proof of concept.

The work is ongoing. The page will be updated as the research and experiments progress.
